answer: Every identity keeps a mirror ledger: each job it claims is reflected there for any stranger to replay. Once per epoch a wander audit roams the ledgers and re-checks a random slice of past work, so faked history is caught without warning. Mirrors that match are stacked on a single ledge, and the ledge pays one reward no matter how many stand on it. N clones pay n ledge bonds and n wander audits yet split one payout, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its share.
